text:
Afternoon training team,
Our newest handler sent an update on handover notes

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through a busy stretch of routine cases and follow-up calls. I want to acknowledge the care shown in each handoff, especially when the details are small but the stakes are high. Safety always comes first in our work, and that includes making sure every traveler, crate check, and comfort note is passed along clearly and respectfully.

Please keep using the current note format for arrivals, document checks, and special handling reminders so the next person on shift can pick up the file without delay. When you send a message to another desk or to an airport contact, keep the tone calm, direct, and courteous. If a detail is unclear, pause and confirm it before moving forward. A careful check now is better than a rushed correction later, and it helps protect the animals and the people who rely on us.

I also want to remind everyone that our service is a shared responsibility from first contact to final handover. Small updates about feeding, water intake, rest breaks, and carrier condition make a real difference in the travel experience. Please continue to support one another by leaving notes that are easy to read, complete, and timely. This makes the work smoother for the next handler and reinforces the standard Aurelia Skyways expects from us every day.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
